title: Chicago Police Assisted HSI Surveillance of Activists
excerpt: Local police near Chicago helped federal agents track Minnesota anti-ICE activists, despite state sanctuary laws.
body_html:
Local law enforcement officers in and around Chicago assisted federal investigative agents in tracking activists based in Minnesota.

The individuals targeted were participating in activities protected under the First Amendment.

This cooperation occurred despite the presence of sanctuary laws in Illinois designed to limit local entanglement with federal immigration enforcement operations.
